subject: range: wrongly skip the candidate in the extractBestCNFItemRanges (#62585)
summary: Reviewed the single functional change in `pkg/util/ranger/detacher.go` where `extractBestCNFItemRanges` no longer skips candidates solely because `res.RemainedConds` is non-empty (it now only skips when `res.AccessConds` is empty). This is consistent with the intended behavior: partially-usable CNF items (e.g., prefix-index / LIKE cases that must keep filters, or DNF+tail-predicate cases) can still contribute better point ranges for later column range appending, while correctness is preserved because the remaining filters stay in `RemainedConds`. Planner/executor-visible impact is plan selectivity only (confirmed by updated unit/integration golden plans); no Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found.
